concepts.title: Swamp combat at night
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a buildable in-game screenshot concept for Evergrowing, a browser 2D top-down gothic action RPG. A landscape 16:9 image, one complete game view, not a moodboard or collage.
Primary request: show a distinctive procedural-graphics game that a small team could actually implement with code-generated 2D shapes, modular rigs, small reusable material patterns and a restrained retro post-process. Pixel-art-adjacent rather than hand-painted pixel art. The graphic language is deliberate, angular, sparse, beautifully composed and clearly readable.
Camera and scale: genuinely overhead 2D orthographic gameplay view, looking almost straight down at the ground. No horizon, no perspective vanishing point, no isometric diamond grid, no cinematic camera. Tiny player about 30 logical pixels tall in a scene imagined at 640x360 logical resolution, plenty of visible traversable ground. Characters can have a slight front-facing read for equipment but the terrain is top-down.
Art rules: silhouettes built from a few flat irregular polygons, circles, branching lines and short strips. Trees from branching segment silhouettes and clustered polygon canopies; stones from 2-3 flat facets; ground from dark color regions and sparse reusable stipple masks; structures from rectilinear plans and repeated roof strips. Characters are compact layered rigs with separate helmet, shoulders, short worn cape, arms and a clearly held sword or staff. Two or three shade bands per material, palette reduction, crisp stepped edges, modest ordered dithering in shadow gradients. No individually painted microdetail, no lavish illustrated sprites, no 3D models, no voxel blocks, no photoreal texture. Make it attractive through layout, silhouette, contrast, lighting and repetition with controlled variation.
Retro screen treatment: fine low-contrast horizontal CRT scanlines, very subtle phosphor grain, small local phosphor halation around emissive sources and an extremely restrained vignette. The retro effect is visible but does not blur the image or text. No physical monitor bezel, no fish-eye curvature, no rainbow fringe, no smeared ghost trails, no heavy noise.
Lighting: mostly dark, visible ground and clean readable silhouettes, a limited cool gothic environment palette with amber lamps; emissive light represented as bounded layered radial pools and a small glow halo. Preserve negative space and clear warning outlines.
Shared HUD: a shallow bottom strip occupying about 12% of image height, built from very simple dark rectangles, thin muted bronze rules, a small red health orb left, blue mana orb right, four square skill slots centered with the exact single-character labels "1" "2" "3" "4", small side buttons "C" "I" "T". All type is crisp chunky monospaced bitmap pixel font. No elaborate carved UI frames, no huge ornamental skulls. Small geometric minimap in the upper-right corner when a gameplay view is shown. No promotional slogan, no large title, no annotation arrows, no code printed in the image.
Output constraints: finished coherent screenshot concept with a practical procedural asset vocabulary, rather than a painted illustration pretending to be a screenshot.
Scene/state: a dynamic but readable fight in a dark swamp at night. One open muddy island occupies the middle, with organic near-black water pools, a few straight timber plank paths, sparse reeds as short angular line fans, and several dead tree silhouettes at the edges. The same compact burgundy-caped iron-shouldered player at center swings a sword in one bright ivory crescent arc. Five small hostile creatures built from simple angular bone/cloth silhouettes surround the player with obvious escape gaps. One enemy prepares an attack shown by a thin broken amber ground arc. A few short sparks and pale green magical streaks provide impact, not a particle explosion. Three floating damage numbers only, exact text "128" "64" "231", in sharp pixel type. One nearby dropped item is a very small pale gold geometric sword icon on the ground. Cool green phosphor accents ripple across the water and contrast with the warm attack, while maintaining visible ground. Small area text upper-left: "MIRE" and "NIGHT". Keep health and mana orbs and same simple bottom HUD. The player silhouette and enemy tells must be clearer than the glow.
Input image 1 is a style reference only, not an edit target. Generate the new scene described above; do not preserve the reference's scene layout. Match the reference's simplified broad flat polygon silhouettes, sparse surface detail, burgundy-caped avatar, amber light and plain orb HUD. Strongly favor code-generated geometry: few large shapes per prop, broad quiet ground, no tiny painted foliage or texture marks. Keep the basic composition genuinely overhead and readable. Put a small simple geometric skill glyph in each of the four HUD slots above its number.
